scope_policy: Reconcile all 36 production IDs without renaming canonical gameplay IDs, changing content/schema, adding mechanics, or expanding the icon roster.

candidate_reference_policy.purpose: Positive evidence is a resolvable existing record/field value, not an approved binding.
candidate_reference_policy.notation: collection/id identifies an entity; collection.field=value identifies an existing schema enum; base_stats.field identifies an existing shared stat.
candidate_reference_policy.record_evidence: Each candidate includes canonical JSON file, RFC 6901 pointer and expected value for standard Node validation.
candidate_reference_policy.alternatives: Multiple candidate targets are explicitly alternatives or category evidence, never automatic many-to-one mappings.
candidate_reference_policy.no_equivalent_evidence: Absence is evaluated against the full canonical schema and seven canonical content collections, not keyword similarity or browser reference behavior.

entries.decision_required: Approve this as a skill-category visual only, or reject the pack's universal-action implication. Do not create an attack command, free action or costs from artwork.
Guard may visually represent the existing defense category/skill only if approved. hold_the_line is career-specific and has a cost; brace and ward do not establish a universal guard action.

entries.reason: Canonical skills.type is attack/defense/control/reaction, with self/enemy targets and no movement coordinates, distance or evade action. quick_feint applies focused and removes chilled; it is not repositioning.
entries.decision_required: Resolve the unsupported move/evade art term at Gate 0; keep production and integration blocked without inventing movement.
Approve or reject influence as a visual label for existing control skills. Its prompt's field/effect manipulation must not imply a field-marker or influence system.
Approve body-to-HP terminology and meter binding. Current HP must be supplied by runtime; base HP values are reference evidence, not current-state values or regeneration rules.

No unique energy pool exists. Decide whether this visual can represent one of the two distinct pools, or whether an explicit approved labeling/shape strategy permits reuse. Do not merge pools, add a third pool, choose a synonym automatically or infer regeneration.

entries.reason: Canonical base_stats and status effects contain no break/strain accumulation, capacity or threshold. exposed has defense/crit modifiers and stunned has skip_turn; neither is a break resource.
entries.decision_required: Resolve the unsupported break/strain term; no new meter or stun threshold may be authored.

Defense is a stat, not a depleting protection pool. The schema normalizes old guard stat naming to defense. guarded is separate multiplicative status evidence, not a second candidate pool; reject unsupported maximum/fill capacity in HUD-03.

Approve or reject tempo-to-speed icon terminology. Old initiative stat naming normalizes to speed, but a tempo resource, action points, timing formula or turn-order policy is not approved by that normalization.
Approve open-to-exposed terminology and split/open silhouette against canonical crack cue. Preserve exposed ID/effects; do not add an open status.

entries.reason: All six canonical statuses are bleeding/chilled/exposed/focused/guarded/stunned; no restraint effect exists. stunned.skip_turn and chilled.speed_modifier do not imply binding.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported bound/restraint semantics without renaming stunned or adding a status.

entries.reason: No confused status, disrupted-orientation field, target randomization or confusion effect exists among canonical statuses/effect keys.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported confusion semantics; do not substitute stunned or chilled or invent targeting behavior.

A wound is broader than canonical stacking bleed damage. Explicitly approve/reject this candidate and reconcile drop cue with the prompt's blood-free notched body/armor silhouette; do not rename bleeding or invent a general wounded status.
Approve the exact-name visual binding and non-color-only distinction from action-guard/resource-protection/echo-guard/marker-guard. Name match does not confer art approval.

entries.reason: The only canonical reaction-type skill is riposte; careers declare brace/parry/ward, not dodge. No sidestep reaction or evasion chance exists.
entries.decision_required: Resolve dodge without inventing a reaction or relabeling quick_feint.

Approve skill-specific counter visual. Keep riposte separate from the duelist career reaction parry; after_melee_hit data does not resolve WS02 reaction timing policy or justify literal instantaneous execution.

entries.reason: No stabilize reaction or regaining-control behavior is defined. brace is only a career reaction enum; hold_the_line and quick_feint are non-reaction cleanse skills, and heal_hp is consumable healing.
entries.decision_required: Resolve stabilize without inventing brace behavior, a cleanse reaction or healing.

entries.reason: No effect preservation, resource locking or secure reaction exists. ward is a career reaction enum, not documented effect-preservation mechanics.
entries.decision_required: Resolve secure/preserve semantics; do not assign behavior to ward from visual similarity.

entries.reason: No echo collection, stored/resonant effect field or attack-echo content exists; direct attack skills are not echoes.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported attack echo at Gate 0; retain tracking ID without implementing an echo system.

entries.reason: No stored defensive echo exists; guarded is an active buff, not a stored resonance.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported guard echo; do not map it to guarded merely because both use shields.

entries.reason: No movement action or lingering/stored movement echo exists; speed and chilled are stat/status data, not echoes.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported movement echo without creating movement or echo rules.

entries.reason: No influence storage or echo system exists; control skill effects are not stored resonant nodes.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported influence echo without recasting control skills as stored effects.

entries.reason: No placed hazard/trap entity, placement coordinates, trigger or trap-echo field exists.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported trap echo without introducing board hazards.

entries.reason: No barrier echo or field-boundary entity/rule exists; defense/guarded concern combatants, not placed barriers.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported barrier echo; do not create a wall or barrier capacity.

entries.reason: No mist effect or stored mist echo exists; frost damage and chilled cannot be silently converted to mist.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported mist echo without deriving new effects from atmosphere/art wording.

entries.reason: No rift or stored spatial-tear effect exists; arcane damage has no implied spatial mechanics.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported rift echo without inventing rift lore or gameplay.

entries.reason: No placed brand marker exists. encounters.arena is a string key, not a field-marker state model.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported brand marker without adding placement rules or faction branding.

entries.reason: No placed mist marker, marker collection or mist field effect exists; chilled is a unit status.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported mist marker without conflating it with chilled or echo-mist.

entries.reason: No mirror marker or reflection rule exists; riposte counters a melee hit, not reflected field damage.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported mirror marker without mapping it to riposte.

entries.reason: No guard pin/protected tile or location-based defense rule exists; guarded is a combatant buff.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported guard marker without inventing field protection.

entries.reason: No anchored rift marker, spatial location state or spatial-tear mechanic exists.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported rift marker without adding rift mechanics.

entries.reason: No binding field marker or restraint-placement effect exists, and status-bound itself has no canonical equivalent.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported bind marker without replacing stunned with binding or adding field restraint.
Approve generic weapon-slot visual spanning swords, rapier and staff; do not create inventory-management or item-specific art.
Approve generic armor-slot visual including leather and robe, despite chest-plate prompt. No character/class art or inventory screen is authorized.

entries.reason: items.slot permits weapon/offhand/armor/trinket/consumable, not tool. whetstone is consumable and cannot establish a new equipment slot.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported tool slot; do not map it to consumable or offhand by appearance.

entries.reason: items.slot has no artifact value. ward_talisman.slot is trinket, and rarity does not define an artifact slot.
entries.decision_required: Resolve unsupported artifact slot without silently renaming trinket or adding lore/abilities.

reverse_coverage_gaps.reason: These three actual statuses have no exact or proposed status icon among the fixed five production status IDs. bound/confused are not substitutes.
reverse_coverage_gaps.decision_required: Project/art owner resolves fixed-pack coverage at Gate 0 without this increment adding icons, renaming IDs or changing canonical content.

reverse_coverage_gaps.reason: Two actual spendable resources have only one ambiguous energy asset candidate. Both need explicit labels and distinguishability; no combined energy meter exists.
reverse_coverage_gaps.decision_required: Approve a coverage strategy for both pools before HUD meter art or integration; no new icons are added here.

reverse_coverage_gaps.reason: The pack's dodge/riposte/stabilize/secure roster is not the career reaction enum. Only riposte has a skill-specific candidate, separate from career reaction parry.
reverse_coverage_gaps.decision_required: Owner resolves semantic/visual coverage after gameplay reaction policy review; do not invent behavior or synonym mappings.

reverse_coverage_gaps.reason: These existing item slots are absent from the exact equipment quartet. tool/artifact are not canonical substitutes.
reverse_coverage_gaps.decision_required: Resolve generic kit coverage without building an inventory screen or expanding this sprint roster.

reverse_coverage_gaps.reason: The authored telegraph visual key is not a production pack filename; no approved mapping from amber_sword to one of the 36 assets exists.
reverse_coverage_gaps.decision_required: Owner must confirm visual-key handling; do not rename canonical telegraphs or silently bind action-attack based on sword imagery.

hud_prompt_semantic_dependencies.dependency: Encounter identity is canonical; phase/round and active-state values must come from reviewed combat runtime, not invented artwork copy.
Approve HP terminology, distinguish focus/stamina, and resolve break/protection/tempo meter mismatches. Only runtime-provided current/maximum values may be shown.
Reconcile five pack status IDs with six canonical statuses and icon_shape cues; duration/stack values only where runtime supplies them.
Four art action families are not canonical skill/action enums; move is absent and guard/influence are only candidate mappings.
Reaction roster and career abilities/cost/availability require canonical runtime context and owner-approved policy; no free action or fabricated ability.
Legal/focus/selection treatment may be UI state; occupied/marked board locations and field mechanics are not defined by the canonical data schema.
Use only reviewed runtime event types and supplied values; a movement/effect art treatment does not authorize a new event type.
Help/confirmation text and dismiss behavior need functional WS03 context; no generated copy or fake UI is delivered.

production_blockers.reason: 13 mapping candidates remain unapproved and 23 IDs lack canonical equivalents. Fixed-pack reverse coverage gaps also require decisions. Unsupported echoes/markers prevent safely selecting all four B2 archetypes.

Confirm icon display sizes, actual narrow/mobile and wide viewports, device orientation review, Godot imports and output formats. Raster master dimensions/extension are unspecified, not invented. Pack PNG sizes remain tracked at 128x128 and 64x64.
Realistic layouts and reviewed runtime values/action/target/reaction/event policies are required. Source art prompts are not approval of game mechanics or a functional HUD.
Gate 0, A, B1, B2, C and D have no recorded reviewer/evidence. Automated manifest validation cannot satisfy art approval.

No drawing/generation capability is assumed and no art is delivered. Editable masters, both PNG exports, native/small-size visual QA, contact sheets, layout references, licensing/source notes, variants/exceptions and eventual handoff remain outstanding.

closure_policy: Machine-readable preparation may be complete while production remains pending. Art sprint acceptance requires exactly 36 approved icons and all HUD/delivery/gate evidence; this report explicitly does not claim that outcome.
